hook: *Singur* dam, a Hyderabad water source, drops below 2 TMC ft
hook_b: *Singur* dam, a Hyderabad water source, drops below 2 TMC ft
tldr: Singur reservoir, which supplies drinking water to Hyderabad, erstwhile Medak and Nizamabad, has fallen below 2 TMC ft for the first time in six years.

beats.what: Storage stood at 1.95 TMC ft on Monday against a full capacity of 29.91 TMC ft, after the project received only 3.56 TMC ft this year.
beats.why: Poor rain in the Manjeera catchment, and storage capped at 16 TMC ft last year on dam safety panel advice for repairs.
beats.care: HMWSSB officials say the water left is hardly enough for another fortnight of drinking water needs.

effects.label: About a fortnight of supply left

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: HMWSSB will stop drawing from Singur at 0.8 TMC ft, the dead storage level, and switch to other sources.

cards.q: Has your area's water supply changed in the last month?

qs: Which other reservoirs will Hyderabad lean on if Singur stops?
How often has Singur hit dead storage before?

facts.t: Singur also touched dead storage in *2018-19 and 2019-20*.
Storage was capped at *16 TMC ft* on dam safety panel advice for repairs.

viz.verdict: Far less water reached the dam this year, less for city taps

viz.l: Storage vs full capacity (29.91 TMC ft)

learn.t: TMC ft = thousand million cubic feet, the unit for reservoir water

watch: HMWSSB stops drawing at 0.8 TMC ft; officials expected about 1 TMC ft by end-December.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Singur reservoir storage falls below 2 TMC ft for first time in six years

fact: Singur reservoir fell to *1.95 TMC ft*, its lowest in six years
twist: Last year it got its heaviest inflow in 29 years, 237 TMC ft; this year just 3.56.
